title.pt: Passarela de 30 m: da viga que resiste à que não incomoda
title.en: 30 m footbridge: from a girder that holds to one nobody minds walking on

text.pt: não flechar a ponto de assustar (ELS)

description.pt: duas vigas soldadas dimensionadas só pela resistência
description.en: two welded girders sized for strength only

sources.deck_dead_load: premise: 100 mm precast concrete planks (25 kN/m3, EN 1991-1-1 Table A.1) + 0.5 kN/m2 finishes, on cross-beams

mechanism.pt: Momento de cálculo por viga 1.62e+03 kN·m (1,35·5.1 + 1,5·5 kN/m em 30 m) contra o momento resistente elástico 1.67e+03 kN·m: a seção resiste.
mechanism.en: Design moment per girder 1.62e+03 kN m (1.35 x 5.1 + 1.5 x 5 kN/m over 30 m) against the elastic moment resistance 1.67e+03 kN m: the section resists.

verifications.method: simply supported girder, M = w L^2/8, M_Rd = W_el f_y / gamma_M0

assumptions.pt: seção classe 3 ou melhor (resistência elástica)
assumptions.en: class 3 section or better (elastic resistance)

sources: EN 1990:2002, Table A1.2(B): gamma_G = 1.35, gamma_Q = 1.5; Annex A2, A2.4.3.2: vertical acceleration of footbridge decks <= 0.7 m/s^2 (recommended)
EN 1993-1-1:2005, Eurocode 3 - Design of steel structures, 3.2.6 (E, G, nu) and 6.3.2 (lateral-torsional buckling, Tables 6.3 and 6.4)

mechanism.pt: Sob a multidão (4 kN/m²) cada viga flecha 133 mm, mais que L/360 = 83.3 mm: a passarela resiste, mas balança e assusta quem passa — a rigidez (E·I), não a resistência, governa.
mechanism.en: Under the crowd (4 kN/m^2) each girder deflects 133 mm, more than L/360 = 83.3 mm: the bridge is strong enough but sags visibly — stiffness (E I), not strength, governs.

verifications.method: Euler-Bernoulli 5 q L^4 / (384 E I), checked by a finite-difference solve of E I w'''' = q

I_y: second moment of area per girder

mechanism.pt: A mesa comprimida, travada só a cada 30 m, tende a sair do plano e torcer: momento crítico elástico 133 kN·m, esbeltez λ_LT = 3.55, fator χ_LT = 0.0653 (curva d); resistência à flambagem lateral 109 kN·m contra 1.62e+03 kN·m de cálculo — a viga alta e estreita que resolveu a flecha flamba de lado antes de escoar.
mechanism.en: The compression flange, restrained only every 30 m, tends to move sideways and twist: elastic critical moment 133 kN m, slenderness 3.55, reduction chi_LT = 0.0653 (curve d); buckling resistance 109 kN m against 1.62e+03 kN m design — the deep, narrow girder that cured the deflection buckles sideways before it yields.

verifications.method: EN 1993-1-1 6.3.2.2 general case with the elastic critical moment of Timoshenko & Gere (C1 given, load at the shear centre)

assumptions.pt: o tabuleiro não trava a mesa comprimida
assumptions.en: the deck does not restrain the compression flange

assumptions.pt: C1 = 1 (momento uniforme: conservador para carga distribuída)
assumptions.en: C1 = 1 (uniform moment: conservative for a distributed load)

mechanism.en: The compression flange, restrained only every 2.73 m, tends to move sideways and twist: elastic critical moment 7.63e+03 kN m, slenderness 0.565, reduction chi_LT = 0.734 (curve d); buckling resistance 1.79e+03 kN m against 1.66e+03 kN m design.

verifications.method: EN 1993-1-1 6.3.2.2 general case with the elastic critical moment of Timoshenko & Gere (C1 given, load at the shear centre)

assumptions.pt: o tabuleiro não trava a mesa comprimida
assumptions.en: the deck does not restrain the compression flange

assumptions.pt: C1 = 1 (momento uniforme: conservador para carga distribuída)
assumptions.en: C1 = 1 (uniform moment: conservative for a distributed load)

sources: EN 1993-1-1:2005, Eurocode 3 - Design of steel structures, 3.2.6 (E, G, nu) and 6.3.2 (lateral-torsional buckling, Tables 6.3 and 6.4)
Timoshenko & Gere, Theory of Elastic Stability, 2nd ed., 1961, ch. 6 (lateral buckling of beams)

mechanism.pt: f1 = 2.05 Hz; pior caso 0.241 m/s² (1º harmônico a 1.98 Hz), limitado pelo amortecedor sintonizado (μ = 0.01), abaixo de 0.7 m/s².
mechanism.en: f1 = 2.05 Hz; worst case 0.241 m/s^2 (harmonic 1 at 1.98 Hz), capped by the tuned mass damper (mu = 0.01), below 0.7 m/s^2.

verifications.method: first vertical mode of a simply supported beam, steady resonant response to one walking pedestrian (harmonics 1-3); tuned mass damper as Den Hartog's optimum amplification

assumptions.pt: um pedestre em regime permanente no meio do vão (limite superior)
assumptions.en: one pedestrian in steady state at mid-span (upper bound)

assumptions.pt: amortecimento estrutural 0.5 % (premissa)
assumptions.en: structural damping 0.5 % (premise)

sources: Bachmann & Ammann (1987), Vibrations in Structures Induced by Man and Machines, IABSE: walking pace 1.6-2.4 Hz, body weight 700 N, dynamic load factors 0.4 / 0.1 / 0.1 for harmonics 1-3
EN 1990:2002, Table A1.2(B): gamma_G = 1.35, gamma_Q = 1.5; Annex A2, A2.4.3.2: vertical acceleration of footbridge decks <= 0.7 m/s^2 (recommended)
Den Hartog, Mechanical Vibrations, 4th ed., 1956, sec. 3.3 (optimum vibration absorber)

validity.name: first mode below 5 Hz (EN 1990 A2.4.3.2 asks for the check)

self_checks.name: solver vs closed form: Rayleigh frequency from FD deflection
